expect.note: the opt-in expect keys are carried by exactly the cases the docs name

provenance: two `expect` keys exist so a case can say something the harness cannot infer — `mutation_survived: false` (this run succeeded and is still not a survival) and `answer_is_known_wrong: true` (this expectation pins the wrong answer as ground truth). Both are described in prose across ADR-009, docs/support-matrix.md and docs/evals/evaluation-methodology.md, and that prose has already gone stale once: after round 2 removed the key from l4-shop-render-delayed (its status excludes it now), the methodology doc still said the key kept BOTH non-survivors out of the numerator, for a whole review round (PR #12, R12). Sets rather than counts, so a mismatch names the file that moved. Watched red by adding `mutation_survived` to a second case: the check reports declared ['l4-shop-element-reordered'] vs actual two ids. M31 and PR #29 added three more, each for the same reason — the harness cannot infer them from a run: `actions` (a plan rejected before the browser moved spends exactly the pre-plan navigation), `planner_note_contains` (WHICH replan prompt a path sends, since the stub planner discards the note) and `trace_note_contains` (that the trace records why a plan changed). M28 added three more for the shape of a verifier-rejected run, which no status/verdict key can see: `answer_null` (the demoted run carries no answer), `reason_max_chars` (the reason does not quote the rejected dump back) and `evidence_contains` (the extraction is still in evidence, in full). T-M40-2 adds no key: `plan-lint-refuses-a-document-root-extract` reuses `actions`, `planner_note_contains` and `answer_null` — a plan refused before execution is the shape all three were written for — and is declared against each of them here.

triage.note: guards a documentation claim, not the product — the same shape as support-matrix-cites-real-cases and the MUTATIONS coverage check in mutation-catalog-integrity. Also refuses `answer_is_known_wrong` on a case with no `expect.answer`, where the marker would label nothing.
